environment.execution: isolated review worktree, local loopback official A2A SDK fixture, no live models
environment.database: disposable PostgreSQL 17 with isolated schemas; URL and credential omitted

finding.normative_basis: spec14 shared Go/Python WorkerCompletion, 64 KiB UTF-8 result and preserved encoded limits; V57-004 retains real result bounds, not language-specific temporary encodings
finding.reproduction: Identical 65769-byte documents with 65536 ASCII <, > or & result characters are accepted by Python decode_private and rejected by Go DecodeStrict, whose HTML-escaped re-encoding is 393449 bytes. ASCII/Cyrillic controls accepted by both; actual control escaping overflow rejected by both.

implementation: ResultJSONSize uses json.Encoder with HTML escaping disabled and subtracts only the optional three-byte overhead of each real U+2028/U+2029 escape; escaped backslashes are skipped. No number decoding or float64 conversion.
Three consumers: WorkerCompletion.Validate, Streamline WorkerResult validation, Planner mapped StageResult validation.
Numeric caps, finalizer/model-output bounds, request limits, private encoders/digests and A2A transport remain unchanged.
regressions: 18 shared fixture cases executed by Go DecodePrivateStrict and Python decode_private: HTML, Cyrillic, real/literal separators, literal HTML escapes, mixed quotes/backslashes, uint64 max, 65536/65537 text bytes, mandatory control escaping, exact 262144/262145 envelopes including separators.
Real official Go A2A SDK HTTP round trip accepts 63000-byte HTML result with exact text/identity.
Passthrough full Runner and Streamline result gate accept HTML and reject mandatory control-escaped overflow.
Unencodable result value still returns an error.
boundaries: Go pass-event counts include parent tests and subtests, not distinct leaf cases.
The initial post-fix focused command caught a test-only typo (undefined AsError); corrected to FailureFrom before the complete race suite passed.
Literal fixture parameters compactly construct large wire documents; all readers receive real expanded JSON.
Completion metadata and implementation hash are recorded in a subsequent root-owned commit.
